mapper.select: SELECT connection_key, connection_name, enabled, active_revision_id, draft_revision_id, row_version FROM int_u8_gateway_connection WHERE connection_key = #{connectionKey}
SELECT connection_key, connection_name, enabled, active_revision_id, draft_revision_id, row_version FROM int_u8_gateway_connection ORDER BY connection_key ASC

SELECT revision_id, connection_key, environment, base_url, token_path, trade_id_path, token_pointer, trade_id_pointer, token_parameter_name, trade_id_parameter_name, token_cache_seconds, connect_timeout_ms, read_timeout_ms, account_parameter_names_json, operation_registry_json, secret_id, checksum FROM int_u8_gateway_revision WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId}
SELECT secret_id, key_id, nonce, ciphertext, owner_key, owner_revision FROM int_u8_gateway_secret WHERE secret_id = #{secretId}
SELECT last_test_json FROM int_u8_gateway_revision WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO int_u8_gateway_connection (connection_key, connection_name, enabled, active_revision_id, draft_revision_id, row_version) VALUES (#{connectionKey}, #{connectionName}, #{enabled}, #{activeRevisionId}, #{draftRevisionId}, #{rowVersion})

INSERT INTO int_u8_gateway_revision (revision_id, connection_key, environment, base_url, token_path, trade_id_path, token_pointer, trade_id_pointer, token_parameter_name, trade_id_parameter_name, token_cache_seconds, connect_timeout_ms, read_timeout_ms, account_parameter_names_json, operation_registry_json, secret_id, checksum, create_time) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{connectionKey}, #{environment}, #{baseUrl}, #{tokenPath}, #{tradeIdPath}, #{tokenPointer}, #{tradeIdPointer}, #{tokenParameterName}, #{tradeIdParameterName}, #{tokenCacheSeconds}, #{connectTimeoutMillis}, #{readTimeoutMillis}, #{accountParameterNamesJson}, #{operationRegistryJson}, #{secretId}, #{checksum}, NOW())

INSERT INTO int_u8_gateway_secret (secret_id, key_id, nonce, ciphertext, owner_key, owner_revision, create_time) VALUES (#{secretId}, #{keyId}, #{nonce}, #{ciphertext}, #{ownerKey}, #{ownerRevision}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE int_u8_gateway_revision SET last_test_json = #{lastTestJson} WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId}
UPDATE int_u8_gateway_connection SET draft_revision_id = #{draftRevisionId}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE connection_key = #{connectionKey} AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion}

UPDATE int_u8_gateway_connection SET active_revision_id = #{activeRevisionId}, draft_revision_id = NULL, enabled = 1, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE connection_key = #{connectionKey} AND active_revision_id IS NULL AND active_revision_id = #{expectedActiveId}
UPDATE int_u8_gateway_connection SET enabled = 0, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE connection_key = #{connectionKey}
